rounds.text: Sarthak Global Ltd demonstrates a resilient capacity for long-term expansion, evidenced by a 21% compounded sales growth rate over the last decade [E14]. This momentum is not merely historical, as the company has achieved a 22% compounded sales growth rate over the past three years [E16], significantly outperforming the sector median sales growth of 11.8% [E72]. Recent operational performance confirms this upward trajectory, with current data highlighting a 19% year-over-year increase in sales [E60] alongside quarter-over-quarter growth [E62]. While the market currently focuses on high valuation multiples, the underlying strength in sales growth [E61] suggests the business is successfully scaling its top line in a competitive environment. Conceded: [E1], [E2], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E15], [E17], [E52], [E65]. The company’s ability to consistently outpace sector benchmarks in sales growth provides a compelling narrative for its operational vitality despite current earnings volatility [E14], [E16], [E72].

The bull’s reliance on long-term sales growth [E14] ignores the severe recent deterioration in performance, specifically the 23% compounded sales decline over the last five years [E15] and the 28% contraction in the trailing twelve months [E17]. While the bull highlights short-term sales momentum [E60], [E62], this is fundamentally disconnected from profitability, as evidenced by a staggering P/E ratio of 1242 [E1] and a negative P/E of -24.78x [E6]. The claim that the company is successfully scaling is contradicted by the scanX signal engine, which confirms that earnings growth is decelerating [E65] and that price growth is outpacing profit growth by 153% [E52]. Furthermore, the valuation is disconnected from reality, with a P/B ratio of 7.03x that is vastly higher than the sector benchmark of 1.54x [E7]. Conceded: [E14], [E16], [E60], [E61], [E62], [E72]. Ultimately, the lack of any dividend yield [E4] and a negative ROA of -4.09% [E8] suggest that the recent sales figures cited by the bull are failing to translate into sustainable shareholder value.
